data_separation.carriers: each pair's 16 carriers = every probe/test clip at the source value, filled to 16 with seeded knot clips: knot fill per pair [4, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5] (of 16); test clips per pair [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]. The knot clips are also in the PCA / ring fit set (full-clip and context-only).
data_separation.kappa: the von Mises readout concentration kappa was fitted by max likelihood on the TEST clips' unedited forecasts, and test clips are also carriers
data_separation.behaviour_centroids: the behaviour centroids b_v (and so the target spline) used ALL clips at each value (knot + probe + test, carriers included), unedited forecasts
data_separation.readout: the native direction probe (W, b) was fit on probe clips; probe clips are also carriers

ctx_ring_provenance.context_definition: frames 1-8 of the 16-frame clip (pv[:, :8]), encoder prefix to point 22, propagate._mean over the 1024 context tokens; the code path of session2_pullback_goodfire.run
ctx_ring_provenance.pca_fit_set: 632 knot clips at the 56 kept values (held-out values excluded), PCA-64 (as geometry())
ctx_ring_provenance.angle: labels (forced, as the full-clip ring's choice at point 22)
ctx_ring_provenance.path_representation: edited activation per carrier (context-only meanpool with its top-32 full-clip PCA coordinates replaced by the optimised waypoint) projected into the context-only PCA-64; shared path = carrier mean. Old test: carrier context-only meanpool + w @ full-clip C64.
ctx_ring_provenance.units: natural-change units of the original file (unchanged)
ctx_ring_provenance.summary_32d: truncation to the top-32 CONTEXT-ONLY PCs
